purpose: Discriminate persistent-JVM timing tails after the short instrument-neutrality screen; no games, candidate tuning or strength analysis.
prerequisite: diagnostic-v1-a01:784 requests,112 exact node-control signatures equal,672 clock requests, maximum request overrun1.712ms, qualified resources and both descriptive median instrumentation-cost screens pass. This does not reproduce or explain historical tails.
actors: Same hash-verified build74 native baseline and build76 BOUNDARY2, unchanged launcher200k warmup, flags3407871/ADAPTIVE16/CP64/Hash64. Two live JVMs but only one request active at a time, alternating actor order by round. BelowNormal; Xms256m/Xmx512m/APC4.
schedule: Same14 full-history roots as diagnostic-v1.14x4 requests/actor/round; rotate root order by round. Reset each actor once per round, otherwise retain request-lifetime TT/history behavior. Alternate the order of actors per request. All responses audited; no outcome selection. Ten100k-node requests per actor before measurement to stabilize compilation. No strength or next opening-selection input.
telemetry: Matched default JFR plus unified GC/safepoint logs (validated descriptive overhead), external wall intervals, existing UCI complete-request elapsed, process native CPU and named Search-worker GetThreadTimes/QueryThreadCycleTime. Locate owned worker via one premeasurement jcmd Thread.print; retain exact handle. Native CPU counters have finite OS granularity; cycle counts do not establish frequency-adjusted CPU time. JFR pauses/waits overlap can distinguish evidence, not prove absent scheduler interference.
resources: 30s idle admission<=2 other logical cores and memory>=8GiB/load<=75%; owned Windows Job; serial requests; no overlapping computational work;40min watchdog. Forecast25-30min based on fixed hard budgets, less with soft stopping. Preserve failures and drain all descendants.
analysis: Analyze all requests, published adverse roots and low clocks, whole native CPU, named owner CPU, pauses relative to request/deadline, lifecycle and transport residuals. Record all>25ms witnesses and classify only what measurements support. No final strength protocol until challenged findings. Historical tail rate would imply only about34% probability of a baseline event here if stationary; that unsupported extrapolation highlights limited absence evidence. Exposure also tests persistent process/GC/generation behavior versus fresh short captures.
continuation: This is one bounded diagnosis, not a pass-until-positive confirmation. No overwriting or same-name replay. If cause remains unresolved, evaluate cheapest discriminating follow-up and fair qualification feasibility; do not claim the historical cause is solved.
